record.name: Help Scout
record.one_liner: Help Scout is an AI-driven customer support platform providing shared inboxes, live chat, knowledge bases, and developer tools including an Inbox API, Chat API, Docs API, webhooks, and sidebar apps.

auth.notes: Authentication is based on API Keys passed via HTTP Basic Authentication in the username field with a dummy password such as X.

access.notes: Developers can sign up for a free plan or trial and obtain API credentials or set up apps directly within the product settings/dashboard.

api_surface.notes: Help Scout provides REST APIs (Mailbox, Chat, Docs APIs), Webhooks, and JavaScript/React SDKs for building sidebar apps and integrations.
